entries.title: From a PDF Archive to a Product Graph
entries.dek: We rebuilt 233 legacy PDFs (1,331 pages) into ~1,500 reusable chunks in a semantic graph. Search, AI answer engines, and the client's own team can now find and reuse the content.

_graffoldScrub_note: false = show REAL client/product names (Hugh's portfolio decision 2026-07-28 — name clients openly). Set true to re-enable the client-agnostic graffoldAliases scrub below. The export --no-scrub flag also forces real names.
_workDescriptionsDir_note: Obsidian vault folder of per-deliverable markdown descriptions. Each .md has `fileName:` (the Graffold assetFileName) in its YAML frontmatter; the body (markdown) is attached to that asset as `description` and rendered in the Work modal. Authored in Obsidian, synced by re-running export-graffold.mjs — same one-command flow as the Graffold DB.
_graffoldAliases_note: Client-agnostic scrub applied to the exported Graffold snapshot (project labels, filename tokens, product codes). Ordered specific→general. Edit the right-hand labels freely.
